<!-- en -->
v0.1.7 is a feature release: the analytics command family arrives in full — temporal query views, CSV/JSON export, period comparison, session ranking, SVG charts, live watch, a report bundle, a read-only health check, and usage forecasting — plus review-driven fixes and a large aggregation performance win.

### Highlights
- New analytics commands: `compare` (two-period comparison), `top` (heaviest sessions), `chart` (SVG bar/line/pie/heatmap), `watch` (interval-refreshed live summary), `report` (multi-file report bundle), `doctor` (read-only health check), and `forecast` (usage extrapolation).
- `query` gains temporal views (`day`/`month`/`hour`/`weekday`/`heatmap`) with gap-filled time axes and trend bars, and `export` writes the built-in dimension and session views as CSV or JSON.
- hour/weekday aggregation is ~5x faster, with allocation count down ~70x and allocated bytes down ~300x (465 ms / 294 MB per op → 90 ms / 0.9 MB per op on a 73k-message benchmark); timezone and DST semantics stay bit-for-bit equivalent.

### New
- Temporal query views. `query day` and `query month` render a continuous timeline (zero-value rows for days/months without data), `query hour` and `query weekday` present fixed 24-hour / 7-weekday (ISO order, Monday first) tick sets, and `query heatmap` renders the weekday-by-hour density matrix with a total row/column. Rows are ordered by the time dimension ascending with a `Trend` bar column comparing each row against the busiest one. `query summary` adds active-days, peak-day, and daily-average lines; `query session` adds a duration column.
- `export [view] [date]` writes aggregated usage as CSV or JSON to stdout. Views: `client` (default), `model`, `provider`, `project`, `day`, `month`, `hour`, `weekday`, `session`; `summary` and custom/configured views are not supported. Output is raw integers with a stable field order (`session` includes `duration_ms`) — an unformatted data surface alongside the framed terminal tables.
- `compare <range>`. Compares two periods: RANGE accepts day/month/year single args and day/month ranges (same forms as `query`). Without `--base`, the baseline follows RANGE's granularity — previous day for a day, previous calendar month for a month, previous calendar year for a year, equal-length preceding window for a range. `--by client|model|provider|project` compares per dimension member (members seen in one period only are compared against 0; a `Total` row comes from each window's whole-range aggregates); temporal dimensions are rejected with a pointer to `chart --line`. `--format json` emits raw integers with nullable `change_percent` (null when the base is 0), two-space indented.
- `top [date]`. Ranks sessions by total tokens descending (ties broken by client, then title ascending, full ties by first-message timestamp), showing the top `--limit` rows (default 10; values below 1 are rejected before the database opens).
- `chart [date]`. Renders standalone SVG charts: per-day or per-`--by`-dimension bars (default), `--line` trend lines (temporal `--by` only, per-point hover tooltips up to 60 points), `--pie` share pies (non-temporal `--by`, fixed 10-colour palette with percentage legend, 100% degrades to a full circle), and `--heatmap` (weekday-by-hour matrix, same data source as `query heatmap`). `--out <file>` writes atomically instead of stdout. The pie canvas grows to fit high-cardinality legends.
- `watch [date]`. Refreshes a live summary at a fixed interval (`--interval`, minimum 1s; `--once` renders exactly one frame with no escape sequences). The frame's grouping table switches with `--by client|model|provider|project` (default `model`; `provider` applies display aliases). With no date argument the frame follows the current day, rolling over at midnight; an explicit date stays fixed.
- `report [date] --out <dir>`. Generates an 11-file report bundle: text summary, a two-period comparison (`compare.txt`, same granularity-derived baseline as `compare`), daily/hourly/weekday/monthly bar charts, client/model/provider/project share pies (provider aliases applied), and the weekday-by-hour heat matrix. All data is read from one transaction snapshot, so every file agrees even while the daemon keeps collecting; each file is written atomically.
- `doctor`. Read-only health check with nine items — config load, data directory, database (existence, integrity check, row count), enabled clients, last collection, data freshness (no data for 7+ days warns), date consistency (`date` column vs timestamp recomputed in the local timezone), unresolved collection errors, and query-view definitions. Bad definitions and warnings never fail the run; the daemon is never probed or controlled.
- `forecast`. Extrapolates upcoming usage from recent daily averages.
- `errors` accepts date ranges (day/month forms and ranges, same parsing as `query`) and gains `--format json` (fields: `id`, `date`, `source`, `message`, `retry_count`, `resolved`).
- `update` prints step lines for each phase and, on a TTY, live download progress with speed; the result wording distinguishes daemon running vs stopped and local-newer vs target versions, and never claims completion for the Windows background replacement.

### Fixed
- `report` month/year comparisons now use the true previous calendar month/year as baseline instead of an equal-day-count window (leap February and leap years included).
- `chart --heatmap` and the report bundle propagate query errors instead of silently rendering a "no data" chart.
- Pie charts with more than 12 categories no longer clip their legends outside the canvas.
- Multi-dimension views keep the headers of dimensions declared after the first temporal dimension.
- `chart` and `report` apply `[provider_aliases]` when grouping, matching `query`/`export`.
- `doctor` validates the full query configuration including top-level `[query]` issues, matching what the query path rejects.
- Terminal and SVG heatmaps render small nonzero cells at the lowest positive level instead of the no-data grey.
- Group rows and the totals row are read in one transaction snapshot, so concurrent collection can no longer make them disagree.
- Pie chart titles no longer duplicate the ` by <dimension>` suffix; the SVG heatmap subtitle no longer overflows, and bar-chart x-axis labels are clamped inside the canvas.

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.7 是一个功能版本：分析命令族整体到位——时间维度查询视图、CSV/JSON 导出、两期对比、会话排行、SVG 图表、实时监视、报告包、只读健康检查与用量外推——并包含复审驱动的修复与一次大幅聚合性能优化。

### 亮点
- 新增分析命令：`compare`（两期对比）、`top`（会话排行）、`chart`（SVG 柱状/折线/饼图/热力图）、`watch`（定间隔实时摘要）、`report`（多文件报告包）、`doctor`（只读健康检查）、`forecast`（用量外推）。
- `query` 新增时间维度视图（`day`/`month`/`hour`/`weekday`/`heatmap`），带缺口补齐的时间轴与趋势条形；`export` 将内置维度与会话视图以 CSV 或 JSON 写出。
- hour/weekday 聚合耗时约降至 1/5，分配次数约降至 1/70、分配量约降至 1/300（7.3 万条消息基准下每次 465 ms / 294 MB → 90 ms / 0.9 MB）；时区与夏令时语义逐时刻保持等价。

### 新增
- 时间维度查询视图。`query day` 与 `query month` 渲染连续时间轴（无数据的日/月补零值行）；`query hour` 与 `query weekday` 呈现固定的 24 小时 / 7 星期（ISO 周序、周一起首）刻度集；`query heatmap` 渲染星期×小时密度矩阵并附合计行/列。行按时间维度升序排列，趋势条形列对比各行与最繁忙行。`query summary` 新增活跃天数、单日峰值与日均行；`query session` 新增时长列。
- `export [视图] [日期]` 将用量聚合数据以 CSV 或 JSON 写到标准输出。视图集合：`client`（默认）、`model`、`provider`、`project`、`day`、`month`、`hour`、`weekday`、`session`；不支持 `summary` 与自定义/已配置视图。输出为原始整数、字段顺序稳定（`session` 含 `duration_ms`）——框线终端表之外的无格式化数据面。
- `compare <range>`。对比两个时间段：RANGE 接受日/月/年单参数与日/月区间（与 `query` 同形态）。缺省 `--base` 时基线按 RANGE 粒度推导——单日对前一天、单月对上一个日历月、单年对上一个日历年、区间对前置等长窗口。`--by client|model|provider|project` 按维度成员对比（只在一期出现的成员与 0 对比；`Total` 行取各窗口全量聚合）；时间维度被拒绝并指向 `chart --line`。`--format json` 输出原始整数与可空 `change_percent`（基期为 0 时为 null），两空格缩进。
- `top [日期]`。会话按总用量降序排行（同值按客户端、再按标题升序，全并列按首条消息时间戳升序），显示前 `--limit` 行（默认 10；小于 1 的取值在打开数据库之前即被拒绝）。
- `chart [日期]`。渲染独立 SVG 图表：按日或按 `--by` 维度的柱状图（默认）、`--line` 趋势折线（仅时间维度 `--by`，点数不超过 60 时逐点悬停提示）、`--pie` 占比饼图（非时间维度 `--by`，固定 10 色序列与百分比图例，100% 占比退化为整圆）、`--heatmap`（星期×小时矩阵，与 `query heatmap` 同数据源）。`--out <文件>` 原子写盘而非标准输出。饼图画布随高基数图例动态扩高。
- `watch [日期]`。以固定间隔刷新实时摘要（`--interval` 至少 1 秒；`--once` 只渲染一帧且不含转义序列）。帧内分组表随 `--by client|model|provider|project` 切换（默认 `model`；`provider` 应用显示别名）。不传日期参数时帧跟随当前日期、跨午夜自动切日；显式日期保持固定。
- `report [日期] --out <目录>`。生成 11 个文件的报告包：文本摘要、两期用量对比（`compare.txt`，缺省基线与 `compare` 同粒度规则）、日/小时/星期/月柱状图、客户端/模型/供应商/项目占比饼图（应用供应商别名）与星期×小时热力矩阵。全部数据取自同一事务快照，daemon 持续采集时各文件数据也互相一致；每个文件均原子写入。
- `doctor`。九项只读健康检查——配置加载、数据目录、数据库（存在性、完整性检查、行数）、已启用客户端、最近采集、数据新鲜度（7 天以上无数据警告）、日期一致性（`date` 列与本机时区重算的时间戳核对）、未解决采集错误、查询视图定义。坏定义与警告不使运行失败；绝不探测或操作守护进程。
- `forecast`。按近期日均外推即将到来的用量。
- `errors` 接受日期区间（日/月形态与区间，与 `query` 同解析）并新增 `--format json`（字段：`id`、`date`、`source`、`message`、`retry_count`、`resolved`）。
- `update` 为各阶段打印步骤行，TTY 下显示带速度的实时下载进度；结果文案区分 daemon 运行/停止与本地更新/目标更新的方向，Windows 后台替换绝不提前宣称完成。

### 修复
- `report` 的月/年报告对比基线改为真实的上一个日历月/年，不再退化为等日数窗口（含闰年二月与闰年场景）。
- `chart --heatmap` 与报告包传播查询错误，不再静默渲染「无数据」图。
- 超过 12 个类别的饼图图例不再被画布裁剪。
- 多维视图保留首个时间维度之后声明的维度表头。
- `chart` 与 `report` 分组时应用 `[provider_aliases]`，与 `query`/`export` 口径一致。
- `doctor` 校验完整查询配置（含 `[query]` 顶层问题），与查询路径的拒绝行为一致。
- 终端与 SVG 热力图对较小的非零格子至少取最低正值档，不再显示为无数据灰。
- 分组行与总计行在同一事务快照内读取，并发采集不再造成两者不一致。
- 饼图标题不再重复 ` by <维度>` 后缀；SVG 热力图副标题不再溢出；柱状图 X 轴标签钳制在画布内。

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级。
